column5: All four public study cards checked: three explicitly AI sample records (including apparent canine lymphoma), one real equine airway allergy project not yet recruiting. The registry currently contributes no qualifying canine or feline treatment protocol.
The displayed active cancer entry samples cerumen for a lymphoma screening biomarker. No assigned anticancer intervention in this record; remaining active entries are outside oncology.
The displayed active puppy study is osteopathy plus an infectious-disease vaccine. No canine/feline anticancer project is listed in the current hospital trial body.
The dog oral SCC drug and B-cell Smart-Start are the two treatment cards, existing protocols. The feline dietary card is for chronic kidney disease. No new cancer card.

Florida roster and active protocols reconcile all five treated entries and UF-MCT observational standard toceranib with owner fees. UF separately lists bone-stabilizing cementoplasty after SBRT as Closed Enrollment while its individual page still says enrolling. No public matching or status change inferred from conflict; an existing post-operative-diagnostic pain study is not treatment.
The single protocol shown as limited enrollment is RNA nanoparticle vaccine for feline oral SCC. No LSD1 inhibitor on this index; audit the separately found program by its own primary.

Read oncology fallback: two equine entries and donation/oral inflammation are out of scope; matched both INSPIRE cohorts, PIVOT-C, XCSgel and invasive bladder IL-12. Liver primary lists 2027-07-01; the bladder card does not extend its 2026-09-30 deadline. Current primary details for the three individually restricted links cannot be inferred from the index.

School roster: sole companion-animal oncologic treatment is the recent appendicular OSA vaccine, alongside three diabetes studies and a cattle toxicity project. Separately read the Enzistat news: it offers two advanced cancer cohorts but the contemporaneous roster omits it, so current intake not established.
The visible roster lists the UQ appendicular long-bone vaccine and an overweight retriever study. The first is the exact existing trial; the second is non-oncology. Enzistat does not appear.

The four distinct current protocols are canine histiocytic anti-PD-1, organoid-selected therapy for dog/cat solid tumors, oral IDO1 inhibitor for canine bladder cancer, and polymer pirarubicin for advanced canine solid tumors. Chronic enteropathy is unrelated. Feline lapatinib reached target and study end 2026-10-31; older dog bladder/urethral/prostate cohort ended 2021-12-01. Both remain excluded as trials.

Only oncology study in the MedVet index is EGFR/HER2 vaccine for dogs with OSA, HSA or TCC. Salt Lake City takes cases; Cincinnati and Cleveland established patients only; Pittsburgh Pennsylvania only; Chicago paused. Other studies cover dry eye and chronic enteropathy. This review covers MedVet branches only, not outside CCA clinics.

Glendale roster includes the existing canine chemotherapy protocol plus active gabapentin/pregabalin and coccidioides PCR studies. Historic canine biomarkers and imaging are not current anticancer intervention.

Exact ongoing Missouri protocols read: oral BI705564, feline high-grade GI WART + COP/Dox, pulmonary carcinoma gilvetmab, and LEAH large-cell CD20+ xCAR-T. Thyroid NIS stains are diagnostic. COTC033 VPL remains printed as enrolling but exact VCT24005785 is Completed and remains outside matching. Historical osteosarcoma-carboplatin timing currently absent; no closure inferred.

The current study list displays microbiome supportive care for multicentric lymphoma during chemo, not assigned anticancer treatment. The separately retrieved MT-003 nasal tumor treatment study is not on that list; no dated reconfirmation from the current roster.

Sponsor calls Australian canine mast-cell personalized mRNA trial recruiting and takes registration of interest. The reviewed sponsor trial and intake descriptions do not establish active treating hospital, confirmed appointment route or owner cost. The canonical entry is already public as sponsor-screened; current matching was not changed from missing unlisted local costs.

New official ENVT Toulouse current research index with eight displayed companion-animal topic cards (IRCACH dog/cat repeated). The only cancer topic studies early sterilization and mammary tumour incidence, confirmed observational by its study detail; no current anticancer treatment listed.

Index links four current oncology studies and a canine cognitive study outside scope. Read all four cancer protocol bodies individually: stable protocol identities; assessed requirements, Fujisawa site, named team and costs; the magnetic-field protocol confirms coverage while the others do not support a free-cost claim.

The sole oncology card is Kirkland/Tacoma splenic HSA. The BluePearl detail identifies four doses of Paccal Vet after splenectomy at those same hospitals; sponsor's exact multicenter protocol has completed recruitment. Stable inactive record; other dog/cat cards are biobank or non-oncology.

One oncology trial in VSEC active body; remaining protocols concern probiotic management of canine enteropathy and feline CKD diet. UCC study randomized mogamulizumab/placebo with mandatory three-week radiation for both arms and oral firocoxib; excluded prior tumour treatment, obstruction/hydronephrosis, IRIS 3–4 CKD and serious competing illness. No owner-cost breakdown published.

Seven topics: feline HCM, canine MUO, dry eye, survivin cancer vaccination, IBD, canine BCNU glioma and epilepsy. Survivin invitation remains current with research end 2027-03-31, already recorded; BCNU study period ended 2026-03-31 and no new intake invitation in roster. Other programmes not oncology.

Current oncology index offers a single Gifu feline oral SCC protocol; detail confirms five days radiation plus supplied SQAP, routine care owner paid, 1/3/6mo follow-up and direct oncology contact. No enrollment cutoff published.

Individual protocol-scoped source: new photosensitizer photodynamic study in dogs and cats with tumours. Citations describe earlier published preclinical and canine cohorts and do not represent new recruiting protocols. No published patient cutoff or owner cost sheet.
Cornell oral oncology lab has one active canine oral SCC targeted-oral therapy, same Cornell oncology protocol; other lab material is investigator work without owner cancer enrollment.

The current UF neurology roster's single antitumour project is Boxer glioma autogenic vaccine. Other recruiting projects cover Chiari-like disorder and nononcologic neurologic disease; no distinct brain cancer treatment found here.

Boulder CASE linked current treatment-naïve B-cell protocol names the same clinical compound BI 705564 as Missouri and the same dosage trial. Past chemo/verdinexor/RT and immunotherapy criteria retained with local contact terms; not a separate trial.

Ardent landing still advertises its IIB appendicular OSA post-amputation vaccine/checkpoint study. Structured linked VCT25005864, 19 listed hospitals, and exact current AVMA Completed control. Partner page describes development, not another distinct active owner cohort.

The Edmonds active trial body contains gold nanoparticle photothermal, canine superficial SCC intratumoral carboplatin and EGFR/HER2. Distinct gilvetmab+EGFR HSA, canine and feline Paccal and lymphoma are labeled closed. Upcoming TLR789 and fecal-transfer projects do not demonstrate enrollment. New Page/AT-014 and Immunocidin links need separate explicit phase checks.

Sponsor master and both individual protocols agree recruitment completed: canine post-splenectomy paclitaxel at eight named institutions and distinct feline solid tumour dose-finding. Neither presents current slots; no feline matchable equivalent.

University Bologna's three protocol lines are all explicitly CONCLUSO: canine appendicular OSA, malignant melanoma and visceral/cardiac hemangiosarcoma. General patient-recruitment heading does not reopen any line.
Stamford master links canine hematocrit/coagulation-testing study and expressly no active feline study. Ithaca is a different site, already audited under Cornell.

Five current project cards: dry eye, shunt/liver, feline mammary GCN2-IN-6, cardiac monitoring in dogs receiving chemotherapy, and fluorescent lifetime surgical guidance. Mammary study is exact existing antitumour cohort; monitoring and fluorescence guidance remain diagnostics/support, no anticancer allocation for those cards.

VOC open category includes undated dog inflammatory mammary Palladia/NSAID, masitinib AB07008, feline mammary Palladia and canine COX2-associated mevacoxib. Bone tumour multimodal analgesia is supportive. Detail pages lack dated current owner intake; do not mistake undated archive/navigation for activation.

Mars reader shell reconciled with public gallery: all 12 cards; only VCA Dallas HIFU/doxorubicin nodal lymphoma is in-scope owner recruitment. The BluePearl clinical fallback shows exact completed canine Paccal. Remaining 11 Mars entries are non-oncology, screening or biobank.

Research page offers feline osteoarthritis screening and the named anticancer canine anti-PD-L1 protocol. Lung-metastatic oral malignant melanoma is the stated qualifying example; unspecified other tumours do not expand eligibility without individualized documentation.

Metropolitan source-scoped roster: SOLID after CHOP at Akron and Cleveland, ePUSH Akron only, the local $1000 surgery contribution and funded phase 2. Feline ctDNA and IDEXX collection are non-treatment; CARE/WINK non-oncologic. Ethos exact source restriction does not invalidate current local branch evidence.

Official oncology roster and specific protocol bodies opened with Web after shell yielded empty HTML. Four existing intervention cohorts verified individually. CMP-002 is existing early dose escalation, nonpublic; iris cohort diagnostic only. General master use and protocols independently reconciled; intake East Lansing. No new calendar limit from body; matched existing AVMA dates where present.
Current programme index labels both CIE and oral melanoma closed. Direct melanoma body has same closed label; post-study product access for study participants is not an open trial.

Sponsor site, pipeline, FAM-010 and trial-partner route agree investigational program for post-splenectomy HSA, with enrolment soon and ability to inquire meanwhile. Preserve owner-approved explicit upcoming card, do not assert current dosing slots. Pipeline lymphoma/dermatitis is not an additional recruiting trial.

Native current public JSON gallery paginated with 500+359=859 distinct records and identical declared total. 113 Recruiting of all conditions. Filtered 61 likely oncology candidates and examined permitted individual public protocol data; positive, excluded and ambiguous identity decisions are in discovery-leads. Several precise interventions and current branch access remain unresolved and no full clinical roster is claimed.

Single active card in the Auburn index: oral palbociclib for five specifically listed canine progressive measurable malignancies. Main detail and PDF both include histiocytic sarcoma, though an internal heading omits it. Initial screen owner paid then up to two treatment months covered. No separately listed sentinel-node protocol.

Only current listed oncology project is the Oregon State multicentric lymphoma microbiome study. Swabs before/during CHOP or single-agent doxorubicin compare microbiota; treatment used as background; exam fees discounted, other owner costs. Canonical remains observational and unavailable.

Of nine active Tennessee cards, only the prospective canine thyroid carcinoma entry is oncology-related. Its primary PDF requires one blood draw to evaluate hormone/antibody levels and offers no assigned anticancer therapy. Other cards concern pancreatitis, enteropathy, arthritis, hip or joint disease, feline rhinitis and alopecia.

Eight current oncology cards in UI and July31 official list, same identities: oral melanoma LCMV/TIL and soft-tissue sarcoma anti-MIC/NK are trials; the bone implant is an existing OSA protocol, evaluates mechanical stabilization alongside SBRT/carboplatin and has explicit prevalent fracture exclusion. Remaining five are observations/imaging/coagulation/AI diagnostics. Mechanism/selection gaps on individual cards are distinct from this complete source roster.

Opened broad Purdue index plus WCORC disease and ablation bodies. Current distinct antitumour cohorts are three ablations plus one bladder triple-drug sequencing study; bladder PD-L1 alone and CDK9 closed, OSA amputation-only COTC034 paused, cancer vaccine closed despite parent promotion. DCE-CT/MRS and BDI cohorts use diagnostic outcome rather than randomized anticancer drug. Need one further safety-phase/identity review of Emerging Immunotherapy M029 versus investigational AKS-619d.

The LMU oncology-labelled Palladia thyroid link serves a copy of the surgical pain pilot; both bodies explicitly offer a peripheral nerve local-anesthetic block for symptomatic osteosarcoma, no anticancer intervention. No eligible study in the published research index; cannot treat the mismatched title as a protocol.

ELIAS sponsor roster explicitly labels each distinct OSA cohort closed. Permitted ECIP-OSA-01 individual page again says closed and names University of Missouri; closure of the separate ECI plus chemotherapy cohort is supported by explicit sponsor roster, individual exact restriction preserved.

Vetigenics official protocol table lists VGS-001 oral melanoma closed at NCSU and Mizzou, VGS-002 urothelial closed at Ethos and BARC, and fully enrolled CHECKMATE K9 with all five listed sites closed. These are not Purdue cPD-L1 candidates. No listed current intake.

Pipeline, home page and news distinguish surplus-sample collaboration for four oncology tumour models and future dog osteosarcoma/lymphoma field studies. Sponsor expressly says no pets currently recruiting; no current treatment-cohort links or enrollment channels.

SLU Silver Bullet 2.0 uses oral karonudib in lymphoma, HSA and mammary tumours, project Sept2026 to Aug2030. University related information and Brazil FAPESP grant show research, not distinct currently enrolling clinical site, owner intake or cost. Project end month does not establish recruiting-cutoff date. Need treating Djuriverse and Brazil grant-site proof.

Only protocol at official Lisanext project: personalized postoperative autologous tumor vaccine, first 20 eligible dogs, study costs funded, two named Budapest institutions. The same body expressly says new applications cannot currently be accepted. No current recruiting opportunity or deadline.

Two material projects distinguished: prospective UFPel randomized IV bleomycin ECT versus intratumoral calcium electroporation for forty dogs with confirmed spontaneous superficial solid tumors up to 3 cm, administrative study end 2027-02-28; eyelid surgical technique/cryotherapy comparison, separate and end listed 2028. University project records establish therapeutic identity but no current owner enrollment notice or financial coverage, so don't treat these project dates as recruiting cutoffs.

Exact October 2025 sponsor PD-L1 and CTLA-4 recombinant protein vaccine notice for stage II–III verified across eight sites; separate Nébih signal only describes permission for Hungarian study. No Hungarian treatment-site roster, costs or invitation. Taiwanese sponsor source remains online but does not date ongoing site-level intake; prior state unchanged.

Primary September 2025 notice confirms exact aerosol/injected IL-15 for measurable lung metastases >1 cm from melanoma/OSA, Evergreen Taipei site, study drug free while tests/supportive meds owner-paid. Current link is a dated notice, not an independently dated Nov2026 intake commitment. Earlier evidence dates retained.

Both current OVC species pages reconciled. Dog cochorts: distal-radius HIFU and Palladia oral melanoma active; canine porphysome oral PDT specifically on hold despite undated detail showing design. OSA relapse blood biomarker, oral mass photogrammetry, biobank, T-cell prognosis and on-hold thyroid staining are non-interventional. Feline oral SCC porphysome is distinct and active; biobank isn't therapeutic.

Official Illinois master contains nine clearly distinct treatment protocols and one MRI-only canine glioma study. October JEN-101/radiation/amputation and Z-007 lung metastatic studies are already the exact current ill-osa-* IDs; no reactivation of superseded legacy duplicate cards. Feline PDF age and radiotherapy corrected, no inference that prior bexagliflozin reopened. Other master sections exceed oncology scope.

Six companion canine master cards compared: liver LASEIT, thyroid histotripsy, brain perioperative verteporfin, direct infusion of molecularly targeted cytotoxins, OSA histotripsy and OSA standard control. LASEIT current protocol now one ICU night and surgery next day. Thyroid detailed compensation says $3000 and footnote references $2000; unambiguous prior source terms not rolled forward as fully reverified. OSA therapeutic phases and ordinary-care control distinguished; no reactivation.

VROC master has eight entries. Two exact glioma AVMA current trials are explicitly canine despite species header; CPMV and CRT-NP already completed separately. Histotripsy emphasis differs in title and body; combined-novel platform/compassionate intake not equivalent to named randomized protocols. Dallas HSA VCT25005913 confirmed distinct from Fort Worth VCT26005971 with unclear arm text. Several exact inner links/eligible cohorts still need reconciliation.

All current CASTR relevant project links reconciled: WSU local T-cell engager dose-optimization is ongoing and exact VCT26005966; dog and cat Paccal enrollment completed with independent sponsor corroboration. Direct gefitinib page explicitly under completed studies and names VCT20005179. No current gefitinib slots or new candidate.

JASMINE referral list names nasal canine adenocarcinoma radiation at Azabu and Nihon and explicitly pauses a separate DLBCL research referral. Primary year-specific follow-ups identify historical SQAP sponsor material and Nihon use of SQAP but not yet exact current named JASMINE intake/date or full center roster. Do not add centered only on referral index.

The referral roster's oncologic offerings resolve to PET-CT/RNA profiling and necropsy, a cone-beam versus diagnostic CT planning comparison for nasal tumors, and PET-CT staging of oral melanoma. No assigned anticancer intervention; other active referrals are infectious, coagulation or urinary.

Current Santa Fe specialty hospital clinical trial page explicitly no ongoing enrollment. Past section lists repeated IV Immunocidin in dogs/cats, parallel chemotherapy and Immunocidin for canine lymphoma/osteosarcoma, Canalevia. In-clinic availability of supportive Canalevia is not intake and not an anticancer trial.

August18 direct lab announcement identifies the existing three cohorts: unresected/recurrent MCT, unamputated or lung-metastatic OSA, and oral SCC, in dogs over one with pathology. Investigational drug and tumor metrics covered, site is not published on national invitation, exact drug and current designated participating hospitals remain unknown.

Official treating hospital describes one specific ReachGlio pilot for suspected high-grade canine glioma, SNGR-TNF with temozolomide. Start Sep1, 2026, referral from primary neurologist, specific Puchol site; no calendar end or public owner cost breakdown, but exact current scoped cohort on available official source.

Investigator roster displays one active feline GI WART trial; current individual structured study body active, exact content ID 22785, one site College Station, enrollment end null, clinic contact and owner costs identified. Legacy news is separate evidence for an historical reference, not a second current roster card or a proven distinct trial.

Primary flyer describes clinically treated feline lymphoma plus classification-biopsy research; research does not assign a new uniform antitumour regimen. File named 20160510; no fresh time-specific intake confirmed. VetMed journal archive context differs from a new clinical protocol.

Primary developer describes inhaled Nebumet, NEBULA proof of concept in 30 dogs with advanced oral melanoma, GLP safety and registration development. Corporate announcements confirm activity, without current four-country hospital roster or recruiting dates. No implied slot, coalescing or new retail treatment.

Alfort current-looking index mixes one undated 2019 TG6002 treatment protocol with no published end or renewed intake, a biopsy/stool sample colorectal diagnostic project, and CarboPop pharmacokinetics dated ended June 2022. Current TG6002 patient slots not verified; new organizer evidence needed.

Oniris official cohort confirms local open large/giant-breed appendicular OSA recruitment, interventional injectable BIOCERA-VET cement to relieve pain and preserve bone/mobility, initial visit covered. No new public anticancer matching, no inferred broader multicenter roster or full treatment costs.

Current CICV roster links exact FINDIMMUNE intratumoral canine oral melanoma and SCC study, at VetAgro Sup. Local booking/referral and funded medical follow-up present. Master provides other research services but no distinct active oncology treatment card verified.

Pisa and VOS legacy sponsor page identifies AAHSD 80 Tel-eVax dog/cat; AAHSD81 canine OSA, 82 feline mammary, 85 canine TCC Erb-eVax. No contemporary dates/site opening or exact current intake; old registry IDs studied separately, 2021 feline COVID vaccine unrelated.

Animal program describes Elenagen preclinical and earlier dog/cat pilot work and an expression-of-interest contact across US/Israel/EU. No current animal treatment cohort, local site or owner costs published. The completed Phase I/IIa and planned US Phase II language mixes human company sections and cannot establish pet intake.

Same exact Kiwi injectable Kv9 pilot on owner and clinical pages, explicit current dogs/cats; horses out of scope. 1×1cm minimum residue via FAQ, <5cm before enrollment on protocol, no open wound over STS; tumor diagnostics owner-paid, study injections/rechecks covered. Need semantic comparative review of complete site list and any published feline-specific criteria before classifying sufficient.

Current Zurich clinical studies fallback reveals newly tracked ADAM-12 feline STS, exact ZH226/2024, source updated 26 October, participation possible but experimental safety phase without established patient benefit. Separate feline FLASH oral SCC and fluorescence surgery, canine brain protocols and low-dose vs lattice issues need independent detail. No new Zurich active match inferred from title alone.

News index's single actual registration trial invitation: caninized anti-PD1 for oral melanoma opened Aug2026 at Kamogawa Kyoto, Yamaguchi University and Japan Small Animal Medical Center in Tokorozawa. Reconciled named sites, study prescreen and costs discussed individually. Prior published cohorts and local oncology desk announcements are not new trials.

Yamaguchi master and clinical-study entry agree anti-CD20 for lymphoid cancer, an older broad anti-PD1 clinical programme, two explicitly finished virus/new-drug trials, and diagnostic blood collection. Active corporate oral melanoma study is the exact current three-site group. The undated broad older anti-PD1 page lacks current eligibility, dates or separate enrolment; identity unresolved.

Two study links, both exact published JVCS-CT PDFs read with current individual Tokyo investigator text: organoid-guided dog/cat solid tumors and epacadostat dog bladder cohort. The society only publishes submitted notices and does not maintain active nationwide recruiting, no additional clinical signal in its index.

Tinton Falls hospital study body includes current CHF protocol, feline chronic enteropathy hold, pulmonic stenosis and patent ductus observational surgery, and canine mitral valve. A comorbidity exclusion mentions cancer but no active antitumour study published.

Seoul official radiotherapy practice-development study for existing hospital patients states 2023-06-14 through 2024-12-13 with possible earlier quota closure. The current page still serves this date; no new dated radiation cohort stated. No inference that routine radiotherapy is a trial.

Current public open section lists four datasets: 2026 postamputation infection risk by vessel sealer, 2025 retrospective mast cell lymph node management, 2022 oral melanoma objective for outcome/data sheets, 2021 retrospective IMHSA surgical series. No experimental anticancer allocation or named current intake. The separately labeled closed GIST Palladia is not open.

BTX001 reported exploratory UCC and prospective hemangiosarcoma results, and a current-looking amputation-plus-BTX001 osteosarcoma research reference. No exact open pancreatic or OSA patient recruitment route, locations or cost published; investigational platform is not an open trial.

Two distinct Purdue programs: current cPD-L1 antibody plus vinblastine/deracoxib for UCC, and AKS-619d Ambifect solid tumor proof-of-concept first dose Oct2025 with safety primary. Sponsor releases and partner primary distinguish them; trial-specific current patient referral for AKS-619d not in accessed material. Other indication pipeline entries have no clinic protocol.

One official owner-facing OncoFAP-MMAE Phase I–II protocol, OPBA822022: Lodi, FAP-positive inoperable/refractory canine cancer, four weekly IV doses, costs covered for biopsy/CT/doses and protocol follow-up, other assessments owner paid. No current slot guarantee; exact existing study with investigator contact, no other clinical cancer card.

DVG German-language index linked specific Swiss protocols rather than German treating sites; the January participating feline sarcoma flyer was read. CHF 1,200 first CT and conditional second dose are specified without ADAM-12 or ZH226/2024; the October study has a defined two-dose plan. The same investigator/location do not identify a protocol or allow cost reconciliation. Other listings test camera mapping, PET staging or blood screening, not independent treatment. Saved Berlin alternate did not supply an oncology patient roster.

Two official current rosters enumerate one live intervention: FLASH versus conventional radiotherapy, Denmark intake and Swedish delivery. OSA hydroxyapatite row lingers in the patient index, but detailed project is expressly completed and only exposed postmortem tissue, not a treatment for a live dog. Mammary/brain specimens and biobank are sampling. Study period 2020–2027 lacks exact day/month.

Official foundation work page is a historical report and acknowledgements. Feline oral SCC radiation explicitly completed/published, canine bone antimetastatic outcomes already summarized, HSA proteomics and other past research listed. No protocol contact/active study card for new patient treatment; purchased equipment and BVSC service are not trials.

Charity supports Onderstepoort oncology resources and student training, assistance/education. Full published partners list is charitable sponsors, not treatment sites; no research protocol invitation or active canine/feline anticancer referral.

University programme synopsis last updated 2015 describes development of natural nanocarriers and animal model toxicology, some spontaneous tumor biomarker/target work but no patient enrolment. UPM/NUS MoU fallback is a separately protected exact route, not a licensed current protocol or basis for membership claims.

DBT canine mammary gene construct announcement recruits personnel for interviews on 1 October 2026. The separate IVRI official grant list documents older mammary exosome, molecular subtype and cad-assay science and administrative project dates, no current client-owned clinical protocol invitation.
